name: 0046 block 4 - VFD live, sinus ON, 10 min
description: BLOCK 4. As block 3 but with the sinus output filter ON. Delta against block 3 = what the sinus filter actually buys. THIS PROFILE DOES NOT TOUCH THE DRIVE. The rpm schedule is deliberately empty and vfd_stop_on_end is false, so the runner never sends a frequency, never starts and never stops the motor -- the operator is in control of the drive by hand. It only acquires, for the stated duration, and logs telemetry. Ticket 0046 electrical-noise characterization. Same acquisition and scope_channels as a normal run, so blocks compare without rescaling. Heater relay must be OFF for every electrical block (it is its own EMI source, ticket 0035) -- it only comes back as its own factor in block 6.
